title: Leibniz bound for determinants: |det A| ≤ n!·c^n when every entry satisfies |A_ij| ≤ c
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, c ∈ ℝ, and let A = (A_{ij})_{i,j ∈ Fin n} be a real n×n matrix (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) with |A_{ij}| ≤ c for all i, j ∈ Fin n. Then |det A| ≤ n!·c^n. For n = 0 the empty determinant is 1 = 0!·c^0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), (∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ c) → |Matrix.det A| ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * c ^ n
